sub_graphs.title: Fulu: Fork State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the state upgrade process from Electra to Fulu at the fork epoch boundary

nodes.label: Electra State Active
nodes.description: Beacon chain is operating under Electra fork rules

nodes.label: Check Fork Activation Condition
nodes.description: Verify slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0 AND compute_epoch_at_slot(slot) == FULU_FORK_EPOCH (411392)

nodes.label: Execute upgrade_to_fulu()
nodes.description: Perform irregular state change: update fork version fields and initialize new Fulu-specific state

nodes.label: Update Fork Version Fields
nodes.description: Set fork.previous_version to Electra version, fork.current_version to FULU_FORK_VERSION (0x06000000), fork.epoch to current epoch

nodes.label: Initialize Proposer Lookahead
nodes.description: Call initialize_proposer_lookahead() to compute proposer indices for (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH slots ahead (EIP-7917)

nodes.label: Fulu State Active
nodes.description: Beacon chain is now operating under Fulu fork rules with proposer_lookahead initialized

sub_graphs.title: Fulu: Proposer Lookahead Initialization (EIP-7917)
sub_graphs.description: Models the initialization of the proposer lookahead array that provides deterministic proposer assignments

nodes.label: Proposer Lookahead Uninitialized
nodes.description: The proposer_lookahead field does not yet exist in the beacon state (pre-Fulu)

nodes.label: Compute Lookahead Epoch Range
nodes.description: Determine the range of epochs to precompute: current epoch through (MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1) epochs ahead

nodes.label: Get Beacon Proposer Indices Per Slot
nodes.description: For each slot in the lookahead range, compute the beacon proposer index using the shuffling algorithm

nodes.label: Proposer Lookahead Populated
nodes.description: The proposer_lookahead array is fully populated with proposer indices for the lookahead window

sub_graphs.title: Fulu: Fork Transition Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation checks during the Fulu fork transition to ensure state integrity

nodes.label: Pre-Fork Electra State
nodes.description: Complete Electra beacon state before fork transition

nodes.label: Validate Epoch Boundary Alignment
nodes.description: Ensure the fork only occurs at an epoch boundary (slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0)

nodes.label: Verify State Field Preservation
nodes.description: Confirm all Electra state fields (validators, balances, participation, sync committees, pending operations) are preserved unchanged

nodes.label: Post-Fork State Validated
nodes.description: Fulu state has been validated with correct fork fields and preserved Electra data

nodes.label: Fork Transition Rejected
nodes.description: Fork transition failed validation (wrong epoch, corrupted state)

ambiguities.text: No specification of behavior if a node misses the fork epoch and syncs past it
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes syncing past the fork epoch apply upgrade_to_fulu retroactively during state replay at the correct epoch boundary. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: For genesis networks, the upgrade function 'applies directly to the genesis state' without specifying how fork.previous_version is handled
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume fork.previous_version is set to FULU_FORK_VERSION itself (same as current_version) for genesis networks, as there is no prior fork. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes in the network agree on FULU_FORK_EPOCH = 411392 and activate simultaneously
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network split if some nodes fork at different epochs, creating two incompatible chains

implicit_assumptions.description: The proposer lookahead initialization at fork time is deterministic and produces identical results on all nodes
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes would disagree on proposer assignments post-fork, causing missed slots and attestation failures
